user_reported_bug: Site domain working but images didn't load / products not showing on landing page on Preview and custom Domain — the landing page product cards showed an SVG placeholder icon and a 'Royal Sparks Spring/Summer' marketing banner instead of real jewelry photos.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused verification on the preview URL shows the primary landing-page image bug is fixed: Latest arrivals renders 6 loaded real product photos with no SVG placeholders, marketing banner, or branded placeholder. Shop and product-detail image fallbacks also load. However, the requested regression check failed because GET /api/catalog/products returns 53 products, not the expected 42, so the overall requested verification is not fully fixed.

critical.issue: Requested regression expected 42 products, but the preview API returns total=53/count=53. All returned variant_id values were numeric.

action_items: Confirm whether the live Shopify catalog should be constrained to 42 products. If yes, adjust /api/catalog/products filtering; if 53 is expected current live data, update the regression requirement.
Redeploy the same fix to the custom Vercel/Railway domain before production/custom-domain validation.
critical_code_review_comments: Product detail thumbnail images do not have an onError fallback, although current live real-photo and no-photo placeholder galleries both loaded successfully in preview.
GET /api/catalog/home response_model does not expose has_image, so verification relies on hero_image URLs and browser load evidence rather than a has_image field in the API response.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill search for 'landing page product images load SVG placeholder' returned no relevant testing skill. API evidence: /api/catalog/home has 6 featured products with loaded jpg/png/webp Shopify images and no SVG/banner/placeholder; /product-placeholder.png returns HTTP 200 image/png; four no-photo products use /product-placeholder.png; checkout returns a Shopify /cart/ permalink. UI evidence: homepage Latest arrivals 6/6 images complete with naturalWidth>0; shop grid 53/53 images loaded with 4 branded placeholders; real product detail and no-photo product detail main image + thumbnail loaded. Only requested product-count regression failed: /api/catalog/products returns 53, not 42.
rca_of_the_issue: The original image failure appears mitigated by filtering SVG sources, avoiding no-photo products in homepage featured_products when photo products exist, and using /product-placeholder.png for no-photo products. Remaining failure is a contract/data mismatch on the expected /api/catalog/products total. No APIs were MOCKED.
